title: JANUS Meta-Registry — Declassified UAP / Retrocausality / Tachyon / Ukraine Dossier
purpose: Preserve newly surfaced or newly centralized declassified/archival source material relevant to JANUS/TOPA UAP research, with special priority for retrocausality, tachyon hypotheses and Ukraine, while separating document provenance from physical truth.

official_collection_layer.name: Record Group 615: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection
official_collection_layer.authority: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
official_collection_layer.legal_context: Established pursuant to the FY2024 National Defense Authorization Act UAP records provisions.
official_collection_layer.topa_read: RG 615 is an official provenance and discovery layer for UAP records. Inclusion in the collection does not establish extraordinary origin or physical interpretation.

known_series.agency: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
Office of the Secretary of Defense

research_value: single official discovery point across agencies
future rolling ingestion into TOPA archive lane
agency provenance preserved separately from claim truth

documents.archival_content: The document discusses speculative physical models for anomalous cognition/precognition and explicitly includes a causality-reversing tachyon and advanced-potential solutions as possible mechanisms.
documents.physical_meaning: A historical theoretical proposal that hypothetical superluminal/time-reversed constructs might model information arriving from a future boundary condition.
documents.topa_value: High-value provenance that a tachyon/retrocausal mechanism was explicitly considered inside a U.S.-government-sponsored research lineage.

documents.authority: CIA Reading Room / STAR GATE lineage
documents.archival_content: The report discusses tachyons, traversable-wormhole style ideas, reverse information flow and the possibility of a slight statistical reversal of causality as explanatory heuristics.
documents.physical_meaning: An information-theoretic/physical heuristic for anomalous correlations with future target information.
documents.topa_value: Shows evolution from named exotic-particle language toward a broader reverse-information-flow model.

documents.title: Decision Augmentation Theory: Toward a Model of Anomalous Mental Phenomena
documents.authority: CIA Reading Room / SAIC-SRI evaluation lineage
documents.archival_content: Decision Augmentation Theory treats anomalous effects as decision/statistical phenomena and allows a conceptual transfer of information from future to past as a possible common mechanism.
documents.internal_caution: The document cautions that direct application of quantum models to macroscopic biological systems such as the brain is premature without distinctive testable consequences.
documents.physical_meaning: A phenomenological model, not a demonstrated microscopic mechanism.
documents.topa_value: Important transition from particle/mechanism speculation to a more abstract statistical-information formulation.

documents.archival_content: Technical commentary challenges advanced-potential explanations for long-horizon precognition, arguing that the electromagnetic advanced-wave interpretation does not straightforwardly support the claimed scale and timing.
documents.topa_value: Required counterweight: the same broad research lineage contained technical objections to the retrocausal physical story.

documents.title: Preliminary Evaluation of SRI/SAIC Anomalous Mental Phenomena Program
documents.archival_content: Ray Hyman's review emphasizes methodological limitations, possible error/deception channels, the need for raw-data reanalysis and caution about interpreting the reported statistical evidence.
documents.topa_value: Prevents archive cherry-picking: positive anomaly reports must be read together with methodological criticism.

documents.archival_content: Operational tasking evaluations from the 1994-1995 period distinguish descriptive matches from actual intelligence value; many products were rated as having limited or no actionable value.
documents.topa_value: Separates statistical/laboratory anomaly questions from practical intelligence utility.

documents.archival_content: CIA's retrospective account states that a 1995 independent assessment judged the work too unreliable, inconsistent and sporadic for intelligence use and that the program was not restored.
does_not_establish: all anomalous cognition effects are impossible
retrocausality is false as a physics theorem
documents.topa_value: Official closing context and a guard against interpreting government sponsorship as government confirmation.

documents.title: Nothing But the Facts on UFOs
documents.archival_content: The translated report says Air Force Major Blishkin observed a strange radar return/object over the Odesa region on 4 April 1956, with ground radar also involved, and that the object remained unidentified in the report.
documents.topa_value: Concrete Ukraine-linked archival UAP/radar case suitable for source-lineage reconstruction and conventional explanation search.

documents.location: Ukraine and other parts of the USSR
documents.archival_content: FBIS monitoring preserved a Trud roundup discussing an unexplained bright object reportedly seen by hundreds of people over Ukraine and other parts of the USSR on 2 December 1983.
documents.conventional_counterlane: Later astronomical/reentry analyses provide a plausible conventional reentry/fragmentation explanation for the multicountry 2 December 1983 phenomenon; this counterevidence must remain attached.
documents.topa_value: Useful example of why archival unexplained wording must be revisited with later technical reconstruction.

historical_progression: early physical speculation: advanced potentials / causality-reversing tachyon
Decision Augmentation Theory: future-to-past information as phenomenological possibility
RETROCAUSALITY.strongest_supported_statement: Government-sponsored researchers explicitly considered retrocausal information models; this is an archival provenance fact.
RETROCAUSALITY.forbidden_statement: The archive proves information traveled from the future to the past.

TACHYON.strongest_supported_statement: A causality-reversing tachyon was explicitly discussed as a possible mechanism in declassified research material.
TACHYON.negative_finding: No direct tachyon detection or instrument record was identified in this sweep.

UKRAINE.strongest_supported_statement: CIA/FBIS archives preserve Ukraine-linked UAP/UFO reports, including Odesa-region 1956 and a 1983 bright-object report.
UKRAINE.negative_finding: No reliable official archival document was identified in this sweep that empirically links Ukraine, UAP, tachyons and retrocausality as one phenomenon.
UKRAINE.forbidden_statement: Ukraine cases validate a retrocausal or tachyon UAP mechanism.

UAP.strongest_supported_statement: NARA RG 615 provides an expanding official cross-agency UAP records corpus suitable for machine ingestion and provenance-aware search.
UAP.forbidden_statement: Presence in RG 615 means an event is anomalous in the extraordinary-physics sense.

negative_findings.statement: No direct tachyon detection record or calibrated instrument observation was identified in the reviewed archival material.
negative_findings.epistemic_note: Search incompleteness means this is not proof that no such record exists.

negative_findings.statement: No reliable official archival source was identified that empirically bridges Ukraine-linked UAP reports to tachyons or retrocausality.
negative_findings.epistemic_note: Do not build this bridge by semantic association alone.

Run semantic and exact-term search over RG 615 and related archives for tachyon, retrocausal, backward causation, reverse information flow, advanced waves, negative time, precognition, Ukraine, Ukrainian, Kyiv/Kiev, Odesa/Odessa, Chernobyl and USSR.
Reconstruct source lineage and conventional-explanation controls for the Odesa 1956 and Ukraine 1983 reports before any anomaly promotion.

append_only_policy.reason: Historical UAP layers remain evidence of prior state; this dossier appends newly centralized archival provenance and revised epistemic classification.

one_line_verdict: The archive materially strengthens the provenance that U.S. government-sponsored researchers considered retrocausal and tachyon-like mechanisms, and adds source-bound Ukrainian UAP reports, but it does not establish retrocausality, tachyons, or an extraordinary UAP mechanism as physical fact.
